name: shad-fx-ascii
title: shad-fx: ASCII renderer
author: Piergiorgio Gonni <https://www.sekei.design>
description: AsciiCanvas: fills its positioned parent with a canvas that draws any effect as coloured glyphs, in the system monospace or a font you pass.
docs: Pair it with any effect: `const fx = useFx(fire, { height: 0.6 })`, then `<AsciiCanvas effect={fx} />`. The font defaults to the system monospace, so nothing is downloaded; pass a font-family name as `fontFamily`, as in CSS, to use your own. Options passed to useFx update in place without restarting the simulation.
